name: Ciangotchi
author: mutaician
description: A 1-bit desktop pet in your bar, in the spirit of the 1997 originals: feed it, scrub it clean, cuddle it, and let it out to roam your screen and climb your windows. It hatches, grows, and evolves with the care you give.
